storage.quotaHint: Empty means no limit. Originals are never removed automatically. Sizes are logical: other hard links may retain data after cleanup.

restart.about: Restart OpenClaw to apply changes that require a restart. Settings and saved data are kept. Current replies and tasks may be interrupted; agents and Telegram will briefly disconnect. This does not reboot your computer.
restart.confirm: Restart Gateway now? Let important tasks finish first. The panel will check that the connection returns.
restart.waiting: Restart requested. Waiting for Gateway to reconnect. This may take up to two minutes.
restart.success: Gateway has reconnected after the restart request.
restart.busy: A restart is already in progress. Wait and refresh the status.
restart.unavailable: Gateway is not connected. This button sends a command to a running service and cannot start a stopped service. Check your local installation or server.
restart.rejected: Gateway rejected the restart command. Check connection permissions and the system log.
restart.unconfirmed: Reconnection was not confirmed. Do not retry immediately: refresh the status and check the connection. The command outcome is still unknown.

ai.subscriptionTitle: Or sign in with a subscription, no key:

keySteps.google: Google AI Studio opens → click "Create API key" → pick (or create) a project → copy the key (starts with AIza…). Note: a Google AI Pro subscription does not pay for the API; the key has its own free tier and billing.
keySteps.openai: Click "Create new secret key" and copy it (starts with sk-…); it is shown once. ChatGPT Plus does not pay for the API — use subscription sign-in for that.
keySteps.anthropic: Click "Create Key" and copy it (starts with sk-ant-…). Connect a Claude Pro/Max subscription with a setup-token.
keySteps.deepseek: Click "Create new API key" and copy it. Your DeepSeek balance must be topped up.
keySteps.moonshot: Under API Keys click "Create API Key" and copy it.
keySteps.zai: Click "Add new API key" and copy it.
keySteps.openrouter: Click "Create Key" and copy it (starts with sk-or-…).

ai.switchedModel: The default (Pro) model is not available on a free key, so the free Gemini Flash model was connected.

models.title: AI models
models.lead: The main model always answers first. If it hits a limit, the key runs out of money or the provider is overloaded, the next model in the list answers that message. The next message goes to the main model again.
models.notReadyHint: A model marked “no access” has no key or subscription connected, so OpenClaw skips it. Connect it with “Connect a new AI” or remove it from the list.
models.pick: A model of an AI you already connected…
models.noChoices: No other models of connected AIs — connect a new AI
models.connectHint: The key or subscription is added as a backup model: the main model stays as it is.
models.full: At most {n} backup models. Remove one to add another.
models.saveFirst: Save your changes before connecting a new AI.
models.tip: Cheap and reliable: DeepSeek V4 Flash (≈ $0.14 / $0.28 per 1M tokens), GLM-5.3-Flash, Gemini Flash-Lite. Back up a ChatGPT Plus subscription with a pay-as-you-go key.
models.followers: Junior agents with “same as the main assistant” AI use this same list: when the limit runs out, they switch to the backup too.

free.title: Free models (experimental)
free.lead: For junior agents in personal-assistant mode. Paste free keys from providers — the server pools their free limits and switches when one runs out. The main assistant always uses your main AI.
free.warn1: Lower, varying quality: these are not top models, and limits run out by evening (reset at 00:00 UTC).
free.warn2: Fine for simple tasks: reminders, ideas, summaries. Give important agents their own key.
free.warn3: Personal use only. Each provider's free-tier terms apply.
free.ready: Ready: pick free models when you create a junior agent.
free.startWithGoogle: Start with Google AI Studio — it has the largest free limits. Agents need models with token headroom: some free tiers allow less than one agent request.
free.othersHint: These may need a card, Chinese ID verification or special conditions — check the provider's site.

folder.empty: The folder is empty so far.

sync.title: Specialists’ folder exchange
sync.unavailable: Exchange status is unavailable. Refresh later or check the Gateway connection.

issues.file_too_large: Over 32 MiB. Reduce the file or move it outside this folder; other files continue exchanging.
issues.unsupported_file: Links and special files are skipped. Put a regular file here.

google.s1text: Free. Sign in with your Google account and create a new project (e.g. ClawDesk).
google.s3text: Click “Get started”, name it ClawDesk, enter your email, choose “External”.
google.publishText: On the “Audience” page click “Publish app” and confirm. Otherwise Google cuts the access every 7 days. Google review is not needed for personal use.
google.s4text: Application type: “Desktop app”. Then click “Download JSON”.
google.allowChanges: Let the assistant make changes (send mail, edit documents)
google.readonlyHint: Read-only: the assistant reads mail and files but never sends or changes anything.
google.changesHint: The assistant may send mail and change files. Risky actions still need your approval.
google.unverifiedHint: Google will warn “Google hasn’t verified this app” — it is your own app. Click “Advanced”, then “Go to ClawDesk (unsafe)”.
google.pasteHint: After sign-in Google opens http://localhost… — it may not load, that is fine. Copy the address from the address bar and paste it here.
google.failed: Could not sign in to Google ({reason}). Try again.
google.confirmRemove: Disconnect this Google account? The assistant will no longer see your mail and files.
google.connectedHint: The assistant works with Google through the gog tool. Its commands go through approvals.
google.noGog: Google is not available on this server — update ClawDesk.

suggest.files: Which files are in the files folder?

state.image: passed on as an image; no text was extracted

error.storage_unavailable: Storage usage could not be verified. Check Docker and folder access, then refresh. Configured quotas block new downloads until verification.

system.title: System
system.subtitle: Backups and resetting the panel
system.deleteBackupConfirm: Delete backup “{name}” from the server? This cannot be undone. Current application data and previously downloaded copies will be kept.
system.backupBusy: A backup operation is running. Wait for it to finish before deleting.
system.backupGone: The backup is no longer available. The list will be refreshed.
system.backupDeleteFailed: Deletion could not be confirmed. Check the list and server connection before retrying.
system.backupsAbout: Every night (03:00–06:00) the server makes a backup; the last 7 are kept. A backup has everything: agents, chats, AI keys, Telegram, Google and Notion connections, the panel password and the shared files folder.
system.unavailable: Backups work in the panel installed on a server. Development mode has none.
system.noBackups: No backups yet. The first comes tonight — or press “Back up now”.
system.downloadAbout: A backup holds every key and token, so the copy is encrypted with a password. Remember it: the copy cannot be opened without it, and it is not stored anywhere.
system.restoreHint: To restore a backup (from the server or a downloaded copy), run on the server:
system.resetAbout: The panel goes back to how it was right after installation: agents, chats, schedules, AI keys, Telegram, Google and Notion connections, the panel password and the shared files are deleted. A backup is made first.
system.resetWarning: This cannot be undone — the data comes back only from a backup.
system.typeWord: To confirm, type {word} and the panel password.
system.resettingText: The server is wiping the data and restarting — 1–3 minutes. Then the new password screen opens. Your owner code:
system.resettingHint: Write the code down: if the page does not open by itself, open the panel and enter it on the password screen.

mode.title: What is this panel for?
mode.lead: Choose once — it decides the main agent, the agent templates and the menu.

personal.title: Personal assistant

audit.title: Action log
audit.about: What was done in the panel (who, what, whether it worked) and what agents did. Passwords and keys never get here.

explanation.gateway: The Gateway operation did not complete successfully. Check its status and logs at this time. After a timeout, check the operation result before retrying.

projectAcceptance.scope: Scenarios belong to the selected rule version. Plan checks and record manual observations here. projectAcceptance.manualHint: Specify the environment and application build/commit, actual observation and evidence. For a blocked check, explain the reason. This record runs no test and verifies no link.

check.observed: Observation or reason the check was blocked
check.evidence: Evidence: log, report or result description

projectAcceptance.pickTest: Pick a test from the latest run
projectAcceptance.noTestsHint: The list appears after the first run in “Project checks”. A typed reference is kept as text but is not checked automatically.

automatedHint.failed: Latest run: the test failed — the behaviour does not match the rule.
automatedHint.flaky: The test passes only sometimes. That is not a pass: the instability needs fixing.
automatedHint.changed: The test changed after it was linked (for older links: its file). Until the scenario is saved again (a new revision), the result does not count.
automatedHint.unlinked: The reference did not match a test of the latest run when the scenario was saved. Pick a test from the list and save the scenario.
automatedHint.blocked: The latest run produced no trustworthy result (environment failure, timeout or no tests).

projectChecks.title: Project checks
projectChecks.intro: Runs the generated app's tests in a separate container without network, on a copy of the current files. Each test is shown on its own; linked acceptance scenarios get its result.
projectChecks.running: Checks are running, this can take up to two minutes…
projectChecks.empty: Checks have not been run yet.
projectChecks.limits: A test that fails and then passes on the retry is marked flaky. Tests run in the same sandbox as the app's code: the result relies on that code not forging the checks' output. Available for apps created by the builder.

reasons.runner_failed: The check environment did not start or crashed. There is no result — this is not a pass.
reasons.timeout: The checks ran out of time. There is no result.
reasons.no_tests: No tests found. Projects created before checks existed have no checks.test.mjs.

errors.checks_unsupported: Checks are available only for an app created by the builder in a new folder.
errors.checks_too_large: The project files are too large for an isolated run (up to 80 KB).
errors.checks_no_files: The app files have not been created yet.
errors.checks_busy: Checks of this project are already running.
errors.workspace_required: Choose a working folder and create the app files first.
errors.preview_unavailable: Could not start the check container. Check the local environment.

projectTasks.title: Rule tasks
projectTasks.intro: The project's executors implement an approved rule through checks: QA writes tests that fail on the current code, the developer makes them pass without touching the tests, and you review the changes and accept them into the app. If the rule is already implemented and you approved a new version, the task becomes a change: QA rewrites this rule's tests, other rules' tests stay as they were. Each works in its own copy; the app itself changes only when you accept.
projectTasks.noExecutors: No executors yet. Two agents will be created — QA and a developer — with the main agent's model. Each gets access to its own copy of the app only.
projectTasks.executorsHint: An agent's answer appears in its chat. When it is done, come back here and press the check button.
projectTasks.noApprovedRules: No approved rules. Approve a rule in “Business rules”.

now.qa: {name} is writing tests for the rule. When the agent answers in its chat, press “Check QA's work”.
now.dev: {name} is implementing the rule. When the agent answers in its chat, press “Check the developer's work”.
now.review: The work passed the checks. Review the changes and accept them into the app, or return them to the developer with a comment.

checkOk.qa: QA's tests accepted: a rule test fails on the current code; the code and other rules' tests are unchanged.
checkOk.dev: The developer's work passed: every test passes and no test changed.

projectTasks.checkRefused: The panel did not accept the work
projectTasks.diffTooLarge: The file is too large to show its changes.
projectTasks.returnComment: Comment, if you return it to the developer
projectTasks.sendFindings: Send the findings to the agent
projectTasks.acceptConfirm: The changes will be written into the app. Continue?
projectTasks.cancelConfirm: The task will be closed without changing the app. Continue?
projectTasks.limits: You do the review: there is no reviewer agent yet. A stage ends with your button — the panel does not guess that an agent has finished. Tests run in the same sandbox as the app's code; that is why the developer may not change tests and QA may not change other rules' tests or the existing shared test code, and you see the changes before accepting. A test belongs to a rule if its name starts with the rule's code or it is linked to one of the rule's scenarios. Only the latest accepted task can be rolled back, and only while the app has not changed since. One task per project at a time.

reasons.layout: The work copy has subfolders or links — files must stay flat.
reasons.changed_code: App code changed — at the QA stage only *.test.mjs files may change.
reasons.tests_missing: No tests of this rule: a test's name must start with the rule's code, or the test must be linked to one of its scenarios.
reasons.tests_not_failing: No rule test fails on the current code, so none proves the rule is not met yet.
reasons.changed_tests: Tests were changed, removed or added — tests must not change at the development stage.
reasons.tests_failing: Not every test passes (a flaky or skipped rule test is not a pass either).
reasons.run_blocked: The check run produced no result (environment failure or timeout).
reasons.protected_tests_changed: Tests of other rules were changed or removed — they must stay as they are.
reasons.shared_test_code_changed: Existing shared test code (imports, helpers, before/after) was changed — it affects every test. Adding new shared code is fine, changing existing code is not.
reasons.tests_unreadable: A test file does not parse as a JavaScript module — the panel cannot compare it test by test.

errors.task_active: The project already has an unfinished task.
errors.task_closed: The task is at another stage — refresh the card.
errors.revision_conflict: The task changed — refresh the card and try again.
errors.request_conflict: A repeated request with different content.

errors.work_missing: The executor's work copy was not found.
errors.rule_outdated: The rule has a newer version. A task can be started and accepted only on the current version.
errors.data_confirmation_required: Confirm that the app's existing data fits the new rule version.
errors.rollback_unavailable: Only the latest accepted task can be rolled back, and only when the project has no unfinished task.

projectTasks.rollbackConfirm: The app returns to the files it had before task {task}. The app's data does not change. Continue?

requests.title: Requests
requests.scope: Company agents' requests up the structure: department manager → main agent → owner (missing and stopped levels are skipped). Agents answer in their chats; here you see the route and history and answer what reached you. You can also answer earlier, at any level. An answer is information or a decision; it grants no access.

delivery.pending: message to the agent not delivered yet
delivery.failed: message to the agent not delivered

requests.answerPlaceholder: Answer, reason for denial or a question to the requester
requests.notYours: The request is with: {name}. If you answer, it closes with your answer.
requests.limits: First version limits: no team lead level yet; at most four transitions; one open request of a kind per subject and up to five open per agent; one day to answer, after which the work stays blocked. Requests do not grant access to documents or services yet. Telegram messages come in a later stage.

errors.revision_conflict: The request changed — refresh the page and try again.
errors.request_conflict: A repeated request with different content.
